content.title: Los Angeles Lakers vs Miami Heat injury report: Who's playing, injured and questionable players, head-to-head records, team stats, and more (March 19, 2026)
content.text: Los Angeles Lakers Luka Doncic vs Miami Heat (Image via Getty)The Los Angeles Lakers (44-25) visit the Miami Heat (38-31) on March 19, 2026, at Kaseya Center in a game that matters for standings in both conferences. With the regular season nearing its end, each result carries weight, and this matchup draws attention because of the players involved.There is also uncertainty around key names on both sides. Luka Doncic and LeBron James are not confirmed to play, which could change how the game unfolds. Miami is dealing with its own injury concerns, so both teams may have to rely more on their depth.Los Angeles Lakers vs Miami Heat injury report ahead of March 19 clashBoth teams are managing several injuries going into this game.Los Angeles Lakers injuries: • Luka Doncic: Questionable (Hip discomfort) • LeBron James: Questionable (Foot arthritis) • Austin Reaves: Questionable (Forearm bruise) • Maxi Kleber: Out (Back strain)Miami Heat injuries: • Jaime Jaquez Jr.: Questionable (Hip) • Andrew Wiggins: Out (Toe) • Bam Adebayo: Probable (Calf) • Terry Rozier: Out (Not injury related)If these players miss time, DeAndre Ayton for the Lakers and Tyler Herro for the Heat are likely to take on larger roles.Israel Iran WarUS-Israel-Iran War News Live Updates: US pounds Iranian missile sites near key Strait of Hormuz; Iran rains down cluster bombs on Tel AvivUAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain announces official start date of Eid Al Fitr 2026‘Trust completely shattered’: Saudi Arabia warns Iran of military retaliation after wave of Gulf attacksLos Angeles Lakers vs Miami Heat Updated 2026 rostersThe rosters reflect recent moves and current lineups.Lakers key players include Luka Doncic (SF), LeBron James, Austin Reaves, DeAndre Ayton (C), Rui Hachimura (F), Jaxson Hayes (PF), Bronny James (G), Dalton Knecht, Marcus Smart, Jake LaRavia, Jarred Vanderbilt, Gabe Vincent, and Maxi Kleber.Miami’s group includes Bam Adebayo (C), Jaime Jaquez Jr. (F), Tyler Herro (G), Andrew Wiggins (F), Terry Rozier (PG), Jimmy Butler (SF), Josh Richardson (SG), Dru Smith (SG), Keshad Johnson (F), Alec Burks (SG), Haywood Highsmith (SF), and Nikola Jovic (PF).Los Angeles Lakers vs Miami Heat head-to-head historyThe Lakers lead the all-time series 41-34 across 75 regular-season games. Earlier this season, they won 130-120 on November 2, with Doncic scoring 29 points.They have also won nine of the last ten meetings between the teams over recent seasons.Los Angeles Lakers vs Miami Heat Team performance comparison in the 2025-26 seasonStat CategoryLos Angeles Lakers (44-25)Miami Heat (38-31) Points Per Game 116.4 124.5 (small sample) Rebounds Per Game 40.8 45.7 Assists Per Game 25.6 29.5 FG% 50.0% 49.6% 3PT% 35.8% 38.6% Recent Form (Last 10) 9-1 (hot streak) 3-3 (preseason-like)The Lakers have spread scoring across the roster, with Doncic averaging over 30 points in recent games. Miami has leaned on Bam Adebayo, who is averaging 23.1 points and 9.2 rebounds over the last 20 games.Los Angeles Lakers vs Miami Heat Key matchups and game outlook (March 19, 2026)If Doncic plays, his role as a scorer and facilitator will be central against Miami’s defense. He recorded 40 points, 9 rebounds, and 10 assists against Houston in his last outing. LeBron James remains productive, even while managing foot issues.For Miami, Jaime Jaquez Jr.’s availability matters after his 31-point performance against the Lakers earlier this season. Adebayo’s impact in the paint continues to be important on both ends.If key players are available, scoring could be high. The Lakers are 21-13 on the road, which shows they can handle away games. This sets up a close contest that may be decided late.
